commons.title: Dance of the sticks at Klukwan Potlatch ceremony, Alaska, October 12, 1898 - DPLA - 66aa5b02aef74bbc4105910788707e6c.jpg
commons.description:
A.C. Pillsbury. 425. Dance of the sticks at the Klukwan Potlatch. Oct. 12 - 98.; General Klukwan location provided.


University of Washington Special Collections has a print of the same photo dated two days later and attributed to Eric A. Hegg, who was certainly in Alaska at the time, as was Pillsbury.

"sticks" probably should be capitalized, and refers to the Tagish people, also known as the Sticks.
commons.editorial_reason: The caption identifies a Tagish-associated potlatch and the image visibly shows a traditional dance performance.
